rows.answer: Each new identity must lock a refundable 200-credit bond at the harbor gate before it earns, and the bond unlocks only after 4 epochs of work checked by random peers. 1,000 fake identities therefore lock 200,000 credits and wait 4 epochs each, while one honest agent locks 200 once and gets it back. A lantern audit samples 5% of answers per epoch; a failed audit burns the bond. The failure mode is a rich attacker who can afford the bonds, so cap rewards per bond like a cedar fence.

New identities stake a small bond near the harbor and earn reputation slowly, like a cedar growing season, so a sybil farm must fund every fake account and wait before it can earn. A lantern of random audits checks work, and cheaters lose their bond, which makes mass fake identities expensive for the attacker over time.
